youth_backpacker_17.behavior: Overnight guests, Day 2 morning. Walk 涵碧步道 (1.5km boardwalk) in morning mist. The most photographed moment at SML. Return by 09:00 for breakfast.

cycling_fitness_07.behavior: Dawn fitness riders. 21-speed gear bikes at Giant. Full clockwise loop: 33km, 4.5 hours. At 8K visitors, the path is nearly empty before 09:00. The Ita Thao→Xuanzhang climb is brutal but no congestion from wobbly newbies. Return to N80 by noon.

day_tripper_13.behavior: Day trippers arriving by 6670 bus from 台中. Walk to 水社碼頭, board ferry. Full circuit: 水社→玄光 (tea eggs)→伊達邵 (lunch). Light Sunday = short ferry queues, relaxed pace.

cycling_casual_01.behavior: The wannabe and their tribe. Rent e-bikes at 捷安特 水社 (N80) — walks right in, no queue on a light Sunday. Ride 月潭自行車道 south: past 永結橋/同心橋, through the 水社壩 mandatory dismount zone (300m walk), along the elevated water platform. 向山遊客中心 is the turnaround — café stop, cantilever platform photos. The return ride is pleasant at 8K: empty path, afternoon breeze. This is the Instagram reel.

family_14.behavior: Families driving to 水社. Park at 中興. Browse 水社商圈, take ferry circuit, maybe rent bikes. Light Sunday means parking is easy.

day_tripper_16.behavior: Visitors heading to 向山遊客中心 for architecture and viewpoint. Drive and park. Walk to visitor center and 向山眺望平台. Some continue to 水社 on foot for ferry.

cycling_explorer_06.behavior: THE PROTAGONIST. The wannabe who saw 日月潭 cycling on Instagram. Arrives 水社 09:15 via 6670 bus. Walks into 捷安特, rents an e-bike (NT$400/day). Rides the dream route: 月潭自行車道 to 向山 (25 min), continues east via 台21甲 toward 伊達邵 (50-60 min of mixed road/ cycling path). Arrives 伊達邵 ~11:00. Lunch at food street (山豬肉 香腸, 小米麻糬, 日月潭紅茶). Then the return: 8km back to 水社 via north shore road. At 8K visitors, the road is quiet. Takes 60-75 min. Arrives back at 捷安特 by 13:30. Returns bike. Still has the whole afternoon — walks to 水社碼頭, maybe catches a ferry for the sunset circuit. The dream day works because nothing is crowded.

cycling_casual_02.behavior: OPENBIKE renters (3F of 水社 shopping center). Premium e-assist NT$300/2hr. Same 水社→向山 route. Light day means they can stop more for photos without worrying about being stuck behind groups.

day_tripper_18.behavior: Charter groups and independent visitors to 文武廟. Temple visit 45-60 min. Some are locals for 月老 blessing. Smaller volume at 8K total.

cycling_casual_04.behavior: Side-street budget shop. Mountain bikes and folding bikes. Physical effort on non-assisted bikes = more rest stops.

cycling_family_08.behavior: Families rent OPENBIKE bunny-seat e-bikes. Slow ride to 向山, extended play stop. Return by 10:45. At 8K, the path is wide enough for parent-child tandem without dodging crowds.

cycling_family_09.behavior: Families who drove to 向山停車場. Rent at 美利達, ride NORTH toward 水社 (counter-flow). Turnaround at 水社壩 area. Return to N83.

cycling_casual_12.behavior: 旅人BIKE renters at 水社. Sole 甲租乙還 operator but fleet is tiny (~20 bikes). Most do the same 水社→向山 out-and-back because 甲租乙還 is only useful if going to 伊達邵 — and at 8K, the return ride from 伊達邵 isn't painful enough to justify the premium.

cycling_casual_03.behavior: Budget cyclists at 松錳 (NT$150/3hr). Same 水社→向山 out-and-back. Longer rental window means less time pressure. Return by 11:00.

day_tripper_15.behavior: Visitors driving directly to 伊達邵 for food street. Skip 水社. Browse, eat, maybe walk to ropeway. Light day = no parking stress.

cycling_casual_05.behavior: 安心騎 e-bike renters. Late-start casuals. Same 向山 out-and-back.

cycling_casual_10.behavior: Ferry arrivals at 伊達邵 who rent from 奔騰. Short ride — 600m over-water path. Photos at fish-basket flower racks. Trivial 甲租甲還 — the path is so short that round-trip is the only option.

cycling_casual_11.behavior: Second wave ferry arrivals at east-side rental. Post-lunch crowd. Same short 水上自行車道 pattern.

v5a_wannabe_ride.behavior: THE PROTAGONIST as a sim actor. Same journey as the cycling_explorer demand crowd, but choreographed to the beats so the viewer's follow-cam finds the wannabe WHERE the narration says, WHEN it says. On the light Sunday the return ride is pleasant — back at 水社 by ~14:20, bike returned, then the sunset ferry.

v5a_ferry_wave1.behavior: First ferry wave. 6670 bus arrivals walk to 水社碼頭. Board ferry for triangle circuit. Light day = 2-5 min wait. Full circuit.

v5a_ferry_wave2.behavior: Families from 中興停車場. Walk to ferry. Direct to 伊達邵 for food street with kids. Light day = no ferry queue stress.

v5a_ferry_wave3.behavior: Late morning ferry riders. Post-cycling tourists rejoining as ferry passengers. Light load — still no meaningful queue.

v5a_wannabe_ferry.behavior: The wannabe and fellow explorer-cyclists who finished the dream route and returned bikes by 13:30. Walk to 水社碼頭 for a sunset ferry circuit. Quick hop: 水社→玄光→伊達邵→水社. The cherry on top. At 8K, they board the next boat within 5 min.

v5a_ropeway_am.behavior: Families who ferried to 伊達邵 early. Walk to ropeway station for 10:00 opening. 九族文化村 visit. At 8K, zero queue for ropeway.

v5a_ropeway_pm.behavior: Afternoon ropeway riders after lunch at 伊達邵. Quick 九族 visit. Crystal-floor gondola photos. Back before 15:00 for return ferry.

v5a_bus_wenwu.behavior: Budget day trippers taking bus 6669 to 文武廟. Skip ferry (save NT$300). Temple visit 45-60 min. Return by bus.

v5a_bus_itathao.behavior: Budget tourists heading to 伊達邵 by bus. Skip ferry. Lunch at food street. Return by afternoon bus.
